title: 2026 Results – Western States 100
claims: The 2026 men's winner was Vincent Bouillard in 13:46:15.
Francesco Puppi finished second in 13:51:08 and Ryan Montgomery third in 13:53:55.
Jennifer Lichter was the first woman and 11th overall in 15:28:05.
Riley Brady finished second among women in 15:42:14 and Marianne Hogan third among women in 15:51:44.
The results page lists finishers by place, finish time, name, gender, age, city, state and country.
